title: Positive Chern generator exchange (some coefficient)
statement: For the scalar coefficient choice some, under the same standing hypotheses and normalized completed Chern arrows as the parent component, the geometric exchange equation holds: the pullback of the q Chern adjunct followed by secondTraceExchange equals scalarUnitPullIso followed by the p2 Chern adjunct.

source.place: Second identity, scalar trace base change before tensoring with q*K.

proof.text: Fix the finite coefficient to the some coefficient branch and carry out the scalar Chern exchange diagram chase from the second-identity proof. The remaining geometric exchange mate, root-normalized Tate comparison, and whole-system Chern normalization are the strictly concrete some coefficient obligations.

proof_origin.place: Concrete some coefficient specialization of the second identity.

lean.statement:
theorem scalar_chern_base_change_chern_some
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (hpl : p ≠ l)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (family : Family l Y) (r : Reference l Y δ family)
    (a : DiagonalTrace.completedUnit l Y ⟶
      r.tq.Rc.R.obj ((DiagonalTrace.completedLine l (ProjectiveLine Y)) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))
    (ha : CompletedChernNormalized l r.tq.toPresentation a)
    (b : DiagonalTrace.completedUnit l (ProjectiveLine Y) ⟶
      r.t₂.Rc.R.obj ((DiagonalTrace.completedLine l (diagonalSurface Y)) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))
    (hb : CompletedChernNormalized l r.t₂.toPresentation b) :
    let Λ := (coefficient l (some E)).X
    let cq := scalarQChern l (some E) Y r a
    let c₂ := scalarP2Chern l (some E) Y r b
    let F := moduleObjectDerivedPullback Λ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)
    F.map cq ≫ secondTraceExchange l (some E) k p hpl Y =
        (scalarUnitPullIso Λ Y).hom ≫ c₂
